display_title: Lionel Messi Continues Historic MLS Run
display_title_he: ליאו מסי ממשיך בריצה היסטורית ב-MLS
short_summary: At 39, Lionel Messi remains a dominant force in Major League Soccer, leading Inter Miami toward another playoff appearance while chasing a third consecutive MVP title.

sources.name: Walla
sources.title: בגיל 39, ליאו מסי בדרך להישג חסר תקדים: "כולם משחקים בשבילו"

paragraphs: At the age of 39, Lionel Messi continues to defy expectations in his fourth season with Inter Miami. The Argentine superstar remains the undisputed focal point of the Major League Soccer (MLS) landscape, recently contributing a crucial assist in a 2-0 victory over New York City. This performance brought his current season tally to an impressive 23 goals and 14 assists. By leading the league in both scoring and playmaking, Messi is firmly positioning himself for a third consecutive Most Valuable Player (MVP) award—a feat unprecedented in the history of the competition.

During the match against New York City, Messi set up his teammate Rodrigo De Paul for the second goal during stoppage time of the first half, following an earlier strike by German Berterame in the 20th minute. This win officially secured Inter Miami’s place in the playoffs for the third year in a row, with six matches still remaining in the regular season. For Messi, this represents his 37th goal involvement of the campaign, building on a recent brace against D.C. United that contributed to a 4-0 victory.

Messi’s tenure in the United States has been defined by record-breaking consistency. Last season, he achieved a rare double by topping both the scoring and assist charts with 29 goals and 19 assists in only 28 appearances, a feat previously accomplished only by Sebastian Giovinco in 2015. Furthermore, he became the first player to secure back-to-back MVP honors in 2024 and 2025. His influence extends beyond individual accolades; in September, he became the first player in league history to reach 30 goal involvements in three separate seasons. Additionally, he joined Denis Bouanga as one of only two players to score at least 20 goals in three consecutive seasons. Earlier in August, he recorded his first four-goal game for Inter Miami in a 7-1 rout of Montreal, adding an assist for a total of five goal involvements in a single match.

Despite a demanding year that included leading Argentina to another World Cup final and his subsequent retirement from international duty, Messi’s commitment to his club remains unwavering. Inter Miami coach Gonzalez praised the environment surrounding the star, noting that the club protects him while his teammates demonstrate constant affection and dedication. According to Gonzalez, the squad is motivated by Messi’s presence, as he consistently challenges them to elevate their performance levels every day. As the regular season draws to a close, Messi has a clear objective: to secure another championship title. While he narrowly missed Carlos Vela’s single-season record of 49 goal involvements in 2025, his current trajectory suggests he will finish the year with remarkable statistics. Messi’s impact on American soccer is already firmly cemented in the history books.

facts.fact: Lionel Messi is 39 years old and plays for Inter Miami in the MLS.
Messi has recorded 23 goals and 14 assists in the current MLS season.
Inter Miami defeated New York City 2-0, with Messi providing an assist to Rodrigo De Paul.
Inter Miami has secured a playoff spot for the third consecutive year.
Messi is a candidate for his third consecutive MLS MVP award.
Messi previously led the league in both goals and assists in the 2025 season.
